faqs.a: The curriculum includes SDLC & STLC, manual testing fundamentals, test case design, defect reporting with Jira, Agile testing principles, introduction to automation, Selenium WebDriver with Java/Python, TestNG/Pytest frameworks, API testing with Postman/Rest Assured, and performance testing basics with JMeter.

faqs.q: What are the prerequisites for enrolling in the course?
faqs.a: Basic computer knowledge and analytical skills are required; familiarity with web applications is a plus, and no prior coding experience is needed for the manual testing portion.

faqs.q: What job placement support does the course provide?
faqs.a: The program offers job and internship placement support with a 91% placement rate.

faqs.q: Which career paths can graduates pursue after completing the course?
faqs.a: Graduates can work as QA Engineer, Manual Tester, Automation Test Engineer, Software Test Lead, or Performance Tester.
